## Objective
- Make the existing Pokémon game “200 times better looking” while keeping it complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Improve the existing game and make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs no wider than 1280px, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Enhance the overworld with richer pixel-art terrain, props, buildings, characters, and subtle animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reworked overworld rendering in `js/world.js` with textured tiles, detailed props and buildings, character shadows and animation, actor depth sorting, a vignette, and a location banner.
- Installed Playwright Chromium and started a new game with Sobble; the Emberfall Village overworld renders.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/overworld.jpg` at 1050×793.
- Tested the trainer menu; it opens and closes, and the party/save options are displayed.
- Resolved the apparent keyboard movement issue: brief `press` commands did not sustain movement; `keydown`/`keyup` does. Player moved successfully from Emberfall Village to Sunlit Trail.

### Active
- Verify NPC/object interactions and map transitions through gameplay.
- Check JavaScript errors and review actionable console warnings.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue testing sign/NPC interactions and map transitions with sustained key input.
2. Review browser console errors; current observed errors are two `/favicon.ico` 404s, with AudioContext autoplay warnings.
3. If visuals change, save a new JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world.js`: updated overworld renderer, collision, movement, and interactions; uncommitted changes.
- `js/core.js`: keyboard input and audio initialization.
- `js/main.js`: startup, controls, save flow, and menus.
- `js/ui.js`: dialogue and menu keyboard event handling.
- `js/maps.js`: map layout, NPCs, buildings, and links.
- `screenshots/overworld.jpg`: latest inspected gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Local game URL is `http://127.0.0.1:3002`.
- `UI.active` was false and `World.state.moveLock` was 0 after initial movement attempts; `press` did not sustain input, but `keydown ArrowDown` followed by `keyup ArrowDown` moved the player.
- Player reached `[14,3]` on “Sunlit Trail”; that map has sign at `[16,8]` and NPCs Pip `[9,7]` and Mia `[21,14]`.
- AudioContext autoplay warnings originate in `js/core.js`; no other JavaScript errors were observed. Two resource errors were `/favicon.ico` 404s.

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

## Objective
- Make the existing Pokémon game dramatically better looking while keeping it complete and playable.

## Requirements
- Improve the existing game and make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.
- Save check screenshots as small JPEGs no wider than 1280px, and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Enhance the overworld with richer pixel-art terrain, props, buildings, characters, and subtle animation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reworked overworld rendering in `js/world.js` with textured tiles, detailed props and buildings, character shadows and animation, actor depth sorting, a vignette, and a location banner.
- Inspected `screenshots/overworld.jpg` at 1050×793.
- Tested the trainer menu and Pip’s battle flow, including move selection, attacks, bag navigation, and potion use.
- Verified signs and NPCs can be interacted with enough to trigger Pip’s dialogue and battle.

### Active
- Verify sign text, object interactions, and transitions between maps and buildings.
- Review browser console errors and actionable warnings, including missing favicon and AudioContext autoplay warnings.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Restore Sobble’s HP or start a fresh game before further battle testing.
2. Test sign/object interactions and map/building transitions.
3. Review console output; investigate `/favicon.ico` 404s and `The AudioContext was not allowed to start. It must be resumed (or created) after a user gesture on the page.` warnings.
4. If visuals change, save and inspect a new JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Relevant Files
- `js/world.js`: updated overworld renderer, movement, collision, and interactions; uncommitted changes.
- `js/maps.js`: map layouts, NPCs, signs, building entrances, and links.
